item.title: About
item.description: I am an Assistant Research Professor at the Georgetown Americas Institute (GAI) at Georgetown University, where I serve as academic coordinator of an interdisciplinary project, “Democracy in the Americas” affiliated with GAI and the Center for Latin American Studies (CLAS). I am examining bottom-up approaches, or how everyday people seek to shape democracy in the Americas region. I am also Adjunct Faculty at the at University of Denver, where I completed a Global Justice postdoctoral fellowship at the Korbel School for Global & Public Affairs. I am engaged in writing projects including academic and public scholarship and my book manuscript.
